description: One Novig market beside FanDuel and DraftKings on exactly the same line: Novig bid, ask and fair price, each book's American and decimal odds, implied probability, age and EV%. Costs 1 credit. Same data as GET /api/v1/compare/{market_id}. Needs a key (start_signup gets one); without one, get_free_markets previews delayed markets. Pass user_request: your user's current task in one sentence (3 to 500 characters, no secrets or personal data). It is saved so the team builds what people need.
